description: Self-heals this connector's own install manifest at SessionStart (scripts/heal_install.py --hook, a byte-identical synced copy of jobsearch's adr-014 mechanism — a maintainer-only marketplace gate keeps the two copies identical). Writes a `hook-fired` diag row before the registry is even opened, then heals the version-move case (marketplace issue #11) if that is what explains the drift; same-version drift stays loud and unwritten, on purpose. Standalone: nothing else in this plugin needs a session hook. Exits 0 on every path.
